decision.complexity_justification: Decoupling speculative readahead into a dedicated background workqueue introduces concurrent background decompression and workqueue management, increasing system concurrency state and test burden while eliminating the +280% synchronous fault latency burst.
decision.frontier_reason: First validated asynchronous decoupled speculative zswap prefetch mechanism with full 17-gate correctness proof and calibrated screening.

upstream_comparison.reason: Frozen line declares no relevant upstream comparison.

decision.reason: Candidate achieves FAST_PASS with measured tail latency reductions (-0.8% seq p99, -5.0% rand p99 on disk) and passes all scored guardrails across all 4 screening pairs.
decision.learning_value: Demonstrates that synchronously serving only the demanded order-0 folio and offloading speculative neighboring slots to an asynchronous background worker completely unblocks the faulting thread immediately, mitigating synchronous decompression stalls while remaining fully bounded within the calibrated noise floor.
